name: WHO emergencies
summary: WHO's third Ebola Emergency Committee met on 17 Nov; the Bundibugyo PHEIC from 17 May stays in force
state: WHO convened the third IHR Emergency Committee meeting on the Bundibugyo Ebola epidemic in DR Congo on 17 Nov, when the Director-General reported more than 11,000 cases and 5,400 deaths (WHO). The epidemic has been a public health emergency of international concern since 17 May and remains one (WHO). No new PHEIC or pandemic emergency was found declared in the past 30 days, so a PHEIC in effect keeps Watch.
for_you: Follow UKHSA and NHS advice if you have travelled to an affected area, and FCDO advice before travel.
rubric_hit: A PHEIC in effect (Ebola, since 17 May) = Watch; no new PHEIC in 30 days

why: A WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) or 'pandemic emergency' is the top official global health alarm.
drivers: Outbreak spread, IHR Emergency Committee decisions.

rubric.alert: A new PHEIC declared in the past 30 days, or a pandemic emergency declared.
rubric.watch: A PHEIC in effect, or an IHR Emergency Committee convened.
rubric.normal: No PHEIC in effect other than long-running polio.
